info.title: Wazoo Platform API
info.description: Management-plane API for Wazoo users, Worlds, platform tokens, usage, limits, and beta billing.

delete.summary: Delete the authenticated user's account (two-step confirmation)

post.summary: Initiate account deletion (returns a short-lived confirmation token)

get.summary: Export the data Wazoo holds on the authenticated user
